title: Figures 93-94: cylinder UAP temperature and Mach number at 200 mph CFD plots
description: Two CFD contour plots of the cylinder UAP at 1/6 scale, 223K and 200 mph with subsonic inlet and subsonic outlet. Figure 93 maps the temperature field (K) with a long warm wake; Figure 94 maps Mach number with a similar banded wake pattern. Part of the BAASS cylinder aerodynamic series.
